fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable entry ID. Prefix shows the category: off-, uno- or ing-.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: The brand named in the entry.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short headline for the move. Blank on in-game rows.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Official, unofficial or ingame (rockstar's fictional in-game brands).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Confirmed, rumoured, new or returning; status_label says 'reported' where status is rumoured (not yet confirmed).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Kind of move, e.g. social post, outdoor ad, stunt. Blank on in-game rows.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Yyyy-mm-dd where the source gives a day, yyyy-mm or yyyy otherwise, blank on in-game rows.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where it happened, when the source says.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Link to the source. Link to it when you repeat a claim.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One or two sentences, drawn from the source.

fields.name: added
fields.description: Date the entry joined the tracker (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: updated
fields.description: Date the entry was last changed, if it has been.
